plan: For capital preservation, sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU, SPAL) to zero.
Trim QQQI to 20% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
This significantly reduces overall portfolio risk and leverage.
The plan prioritizes stability and capital preservation over aggressive growth.
conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% per month. It significantly de-risks the portfolio by eliminating leveraged ETFs and reducing concentration. Expect lower drawdowns but also more modest returns.

plan: Trim all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU, SPAL) to reduce overall leverage and concentration.
Trim QQQI to 20% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
Buy AAPU at 4% as a new, high-scoring scanner setup to diversify.
This plan balances risk reduction with growth potential, maintaining a small leveraged ETF presence.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for risk-first growth, targeting ~2.5% per month. It reduces leverage and concentration while introducing a new, strong setup. Expect moderate drawdowns and growth potential.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU, SPAL) to lean into growth.
Trim QQQI to 20% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
Buy AAPU at 6% as a new, high-scoring scanner setup, concentrating in strong signals.
This plan uses leverage and concentration for aggressive growth, with strict stop discipline.
aggressive.read: This aggressive growth plan targets ~4% per month by increasing leverage and concentrating in high-scoring setups. Be aware that this significantly raises both upside and drawdown potential. Leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this approach can lead to substantial losses quickly if stops are not strictly adhered to.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU, SPAL) to zero to reduce risk.
Add to QQQI, increasing its allocation to 30% for enhanced income generation.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and low drawdown.
It aims to park cash for yield, reducing exposure to high-beta names.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1% per month by rotating into income-focused ETFs and reducing high-beta exposure. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income over growth. Remember, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
